name: page-next
description: Closing links section of the 2026 company pages (Our Company, Figma 7460:105096): an intro column (eyebrow, heading with a gradient phrase, paragraphs) beside a stack of glass link cards (28px icon, bold label), over soft indigo and green orbs.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title_accent.description: Words of the heading painted with the brand gradient (first occurrence); must appear in title.

body.description: Copy under the heading. Blank line = new paragraph; [label](url) links, **bold**.

cards.description: Link cards, top to bottom. Each: title (the link text), url, icon (28px image URL; empty = no icon).
